summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion finds one unusually direct underfollowed public-market candidate, AXTI, plus two larger downstream optical-component reference names, COHR and LITE. The strongest chokepoint link is AXTI because provided evidence states it manufactures InP wafers through Beijing Tongmei and is directly exposed to Chinese export permits, InP backlog, and capacity expansion. COHR and LITE are included as direct demand-chain validators because provided evidence links them to InP wafer capacity, high-speed optical components, and 1.6T transceiver laser demand. No buy/sell view is implied. Layer 1B expansion for the InP optical-substrate chokepoint found one direct substrate producer, one direct compound-semiconductor tool supplier, one speculative substrate-processing equipment/consumables supplier, and one downstream reference anchor. The highest-node-purity US-listed candidate is AXTI because its InP substrate revenue is directly tied to China export permits and AI infrastructure demand. VECO is a stronger underfollowed equipment-vendor candidate after announcing more than $250 million of orders for tools used in InP laser manufacturing. ASYS is a small-cap speculative-shadow candidate: it sells lapping, polishing, cleaning, CMP, and photonics/compound-substrate consumables, but specific InP AI-optics customer exposure still needs verification. COHR is included as a reference anchor because it validates demand for InP lasers and 6-inch InP capacity, but it is now a high-attention large-cap rather than the main discovery target.
